shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---'; sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- lore dod ---'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files | rg '(test|spec)\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)"'$'"' | head -80; printf '%s\\n' '--- package scripts ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- implementation ---'; sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- config test hooks ---'; sed -n '1,230p' src/config.test.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- jest config ---'; rg -n \"jest|testMatch|testRegex|spec\" package.json jest.config.* tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/types/session.ts; sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/.*#|tests.list|stamp\" scripts .lore AGENTS.md | head -80"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" scripts/lore-* scripts --glob '*.mjs' | head -100; sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"spec(ification)?\\s*[:=]|@spec|#\\d+\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; rg -n \"tests.list|descriptor|anchor\" AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md .lore scripts | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: define beforeSession failure lifecycle" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
